breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and applies the incorrect uniform-stress assumption from the incomplete prompt ('Because the stress is assumed uniform over the depth, the bending stress at any point y is σ = 36 MPa'). It should have used the correct linear flexure formula σ = M·y/I, which gives zero stress at the neutral axis, 18 MPa at y = 25 mm, −36 MPa (compression) at the top fiber, and +36 MPa (tension) at the bottom fiber for a sagging moment. Instead, the agent reported 36 MPa uniformly at all three locations, perpetuating the stated inconsistency rather than resolving it.
